tools.description: Find files inside the workspace using a root-relative glob. The search respects bounded workspace-local ignore files at or below the selected search root (rules above an explicitly selected root are not inherited), never enters VCS metadata, and returns at most 1000 sorted paths after scanning at most 200000 entries. If truncated, the selected subset can depend on filesystem enumeration order.
tools.name: glob

include_hidden.description: Disable default dotfile filtering; ignore whitelists can still include hidden paths, while VCS metadata is always excluded

path.description: Directory relative to the workspace, or an absolute directory inside it; defaults to .

pattern.description: Glob relative to path, using / separators; * does not cross directories and ** does; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes

tools.description: Search text files inside the workspace with a Rust regular expression or literal string. The search respects bounded workspace-local ignore files at or below the selected search root (rules above an explicitly selected root are not inherited), skips binary and oversized files, never enters VCS metadata, and returns at most 100 sorted matching lines. If truncated, the selected subset can depend on filesystem enumeration order.
tools.name: grep

context.description: Number of lines before and after each match

glob.description: Optional file glob relative to path, using / separators; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes

include_hidden.description: Disable default dotfile filtering; ignore whitelists can still include hidden paths, while VCS metadata is always excluded

limit.description: Maximum matching lines to return; context lines do not count

path.description: File or directory relative to the workspace, or an absolute path inside it; defaults to .

pattern.description: Rust regex syntax, or literal text when literal is true; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes

tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside the workspace with line numbers. Files are limited to 10485760 bytes and output to 2000 lines or 51200 bytes; use offset and limit to continue. A truncated long-line tail is omitted.
tools.name: read

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return

offset.description: First line to return, using one-based indexing

path.description: File path relative to the workspace, or an absolute path inside it
